## Validation Checklist 🟢
Please confirm that your contribution meets all coding standards:
- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Standard HTML5 tags used natively (e.g. `<button>`, `<dialog>`). No unnecessary nested `<div>`s.
- [ ] **BEM Class Naming**: Elements named following the `.block__element--modifier` standard.
- [ ] **Modern CSS**: Uses CSS custom variables and logical properties (`margin-inline`, etc.).
- [ ] **No JS Overhead**: Fully functional using only CSS transitions, animations, or standard state selectors unless absolutely necessary for standard a11y focus containment.
- [ ] **Accessibility (a11y)**: Focus indicators styled beautifully using `:focus-visible`, minimum `4.5:1` text color contrast, and correct ARIA descriptions where applicable.
- [ ] **Documentation**: Complete component `README.md` following `COMPONENT_TEMPLATE.md`.
- [ ] **Responsive Sizing**: Tested on Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop displays.
